environment.description: Same Rails 7.1 application deployed behind Cloudflare with the following configuration: (1) secure_headers gem initializer overrides CSP per-environment with script-src set to 'self' https://cdn.example.com with require-sri-for directive present in meta tag, (2) Cloudflare response header transform rule appends `Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com 'strict-dynamic'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'` replacing any application-set CSP header, (3) all script tags in the asset pipeline use integrity= attributes with sha384 hashes computed at deploy time via sprockets-sri gem, (4) Cloudflare managed transform rule 'Add Security Headers' is active which sets CSP frame-ancestors and X-Content-Type-Options. The Cloudflare WAF custom rule for the zone has expression: `(http.request.uri.path contains "/comments" and http.request.method eq "POST" and any(http.request.body.form.values[*] contains "<script"))` with action Block, but this only catches trivial payloads with literal <script> tags.

config.sri_enforcement: All script elements include integrity='sha384-...' crossorigin='anonymous' attributes; strict-dynamic propagates trust only to scripts loaded by trusted scripts
config.cloudflare_waf_rule: blocks POST to /comments containing <script> in body values
